CONSTRAINT ck_knowledge_context__target_xor CHECK (num_nonnulls(normative_unit_id, requirement_id, control_version_id, subject_id) = 1)
CONSTRAINT ck_knowledge_context__ownership CHECK (ownership_class IN ('GLOBAL_REFERENCE', 'PLATFORM_CONTROL', 'TENANT_OWNED'))
CONSTRAINT ck_knowledge_context__tenant CHECK ((ownership_class = 'TENANT_OWNED') = (tenant_id IS NOT NULL))
CONSTRAINT ck_knowledge_context__role CHECK (context_role IN ('comprender', 'implementar', 'demostrar', 'contexto_empresarial'))
CONSTRAINT ck_knowledge_context__context CHECK (context_role <> 'contexto_empresarial' OR subject_id IS NOT NULL)
CONSTRAINT ck_knowledge_context__locator CHECK (btrim(source_locator) <> '' AND btrim(provenance_ref) <> '')
CONSTRAINT uq_knowledge_context__semantic UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (knowledge_version_id, context_role, normative_unit_id, requirement_id, control_version_id, subject_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_context__tenant_version ON knowledge.knowledge_version_context_links (tenant_id, knowledge_version_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_context__unit ON knowledge.knowledge_version_context_links (normative_unit_id) WHERE normative_unit_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_context__requirement ON knowledge.knowledge_version_context_links (requirement_id) WHERE requirement_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_context__control ON knowledge.knowledge_version_context_links (control_version_id) WHERE control_version_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_context__subject ON knowledge.knowledge_version_context_links (tenant_id, subject_id) WHERE subject_id IS NOT NULL
CONSTRAINT uq_knowledge_versions__item_version UNIQUE (knowledge_item_id, version_number)
CONSTRAINT fk_config_override__control FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, control_version_id) REFERENCES controls.control_versions (tenant_id, control_version_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CONSTRAINT fk_config_override__previous FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, supersedes_configuration_override_id) REFERENCES config.configuration_overrides (tenant_id, configuration_override_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CONSTRAINT ck_config_override__control_scope CHECK ((scope_level <> 'control_version' OR (control_version_id IS NOT NULL AND tenant_id IS NOT NULL AND ownership_class = 'TENANT_OWNED' AND num_nonnulls(methodology_id, regulatory_pack_version_id, scope_subject_id) = 0)) AND (control_version_id IS NULL OR scope_level = 'control_version') AND (supersedes_configuration_override_id IS NULL OR (scope_level = 'control_version' AND supersedes_configuration_override_id <> configuration_override_id)))

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_config_override__control_revision ON config.configuration_overrides (tenant_id, configuration_definition_id, control_version_id, override_version, effective_from) WHERE scope_level = 'control_version'

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_config_override__approved_successor ON config.configuration_overrides (tenant_id, supersedes_configuration_override_id) WHERE scope_level = 'control_version' AND lifecycle_state = 'approved' AND supersedes_configuration_override_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX ix_config_override__control_interval ON config.configuration_overrides (tenant_id, control_version_id, configuration_definition_id, effective_from, effective_to)
CONSTRAINT fk_effective_config__control FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, control_version_id) REFERENCES controls.control_versions (tenant_id, control_version_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CONSTRAINT ck_effective_config__control_scope CHECK (control_version_id IS NULL OR resolved_for_subject_id IS NULL)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_effective_config__control_inputs ON config.effective_configurations (tenant_id, configuration_definition_id, control_version_id, effective_at, input_hash) WHERE control_version_id IS NOT NULL
CONSTRAINT fk_applicability__context FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, context_knowledge_version_id) REFERENCES knowledge.knowledge_versions (tenant_id, knowledge_version_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CREATE INDEX ix_applicability__context ON regulatory.requirement_applicabilities (tenant_id, context_knowledge_version_id) WHERE context_knowledge_version_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER ck_knowledge_context__compatibility AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON knowledge.knowledge_version_context_links DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE knowledge.check_context_link()
CREATE TRIGGER ck_knowledge_context__immutable BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON knowledge.knowledge_version_context_links FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE knowledge.guard_context_link()

CREATE TRIGGER ck_context_target__unit BEFORE UPDATE OF tenant_id, ownership_class ON regulatory.normative_units FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE knowledge.guard_context_target_owner('normative_unit_id')

CREATE TRIGGER ck_context_target__requirement BEFORE UPDATE OF tenant_id, ownership_class ON regulatory.requirements FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE knowledge.guard_context_target_owner('requirement_id')

CREATE TRIGGER ck_context_target__control BEFORE UPDATE OF tenant_id, ownership_class ON controls.control_versions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE knowledge.guard_context_target_owner('control_version_id')
CREATE TRIGGER ck_context_target__subject BEFORE UPDATE OF tenant_id ON org.subjects FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE knowledge.guard_context_target_owner('subject_id')

CREATE TRIGGER ck_context_source__owner BEFORE UPDATE OF tenant_id, ownership_class ON knowledge.knowledge_versions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE knowledge.guard_context_target_owner('knowledge_version_id')
CREATE TRIGGER ck_knowledge_version__published_core BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON knowledge.knowledge_versions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE knowledge.guard_published_version_core()
CREATE TRIGGER ck_control_override__history BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON config.configuration_overrides FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE config.guard_control_override_history()

CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER ck_control_override__succession AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON config.configuration_overrides DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE config.check_control_override_successor()

CREATE TRIGGER ck_applicability__context_history BEFORE UPDATE OF context_knowledge_version_id ON regulatory.requirement_applicabilities FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE regulatory.guard_context_decision_history()

CONSTRAINT ck_knowledge_source_usage_rights__ownership CHECK (ownership_class IN ('GLOBAL_REFERENCE', 'PLATFORM_CONTROL', 'TENANT_OWNED') AND (ownership_class = 'TENANT_OWNED') = (tenant_id IS NOT NULL))
CONSTRAINT ck_knowledge_source_usage_rights__tenant CHECK (tenant_id IS NULL OR audience_tenant_id = tenant_id)
CONSTRAINT ck_knowledge_source_usage_rights__tenant_audience CHECK (tenant_id IS NULL OR audience_tenant_id IS NOT NULL)
CONSTRAINT ck_knowledge_source_usage_rights__act CHECK (use_act IN ('consultation', 'extraction', 'storage', 'presentation', 'export', 'import', 'publication'))
CONSTRAINT ck_knowledge_source_usage_rights__environment CHECK (use_environment IN ('development', 'test', 'qa', 'production'))
CONSTRAINT ck_knowledge_source_usage_rights__content CHECK (content_kind IN ('metadata', 'editorial', 'tenant_context', 'third_party'))
CONSTRAINT ck_knowledge_source_usage_rights__hashes CHECK (content_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND evidence_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
CONSTRAINT ck_knowledge_source_usage_rights__interval CHECK (effective_from < effective_to)
CONSTRAINT ck_knowledge_source_usage_rights__evidence CHECK (btrim(edition_ref) <> '' AND btrim(evidence_ref) <> '')
CONSTRAINT ck_knowledge_source_usage_rights__revocation CHECK ((revoked_at IS NULL) = (revoked_audit_event_id IS NULL) AND (revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= created_at))

CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_source_usage_rights__lookup ON knowledge.knowledge_source_usage_rights (knowledge_source_id, content_hash, audience_tenant_id, use_act, use_environment, regulatory_pack_version_id, effective_from, effective_to)

CREATE TRIGGER trg_knowledge_source_usage_rights__integrity BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON knowledge.knowledge_source_usage_rights FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE knowledge.enforce_source_usage_rights()
